scope: Editor only; main-thread recorder includes Editor and waits; GC and memory include Editor/diagnostic overhead

rules.validSample: 30 seconds warm-up + 60 seconds observation; Playing with positive game time and no pause/menu/ending
rules.repeatVariation: p95 range exceeding both 20% of minimum and 2 ms is unstable; retain all runs and investigate
rules.loadOrUiCost: increase exceeding both 20% and 2 ms of paired condition is a CPU investigation candidate
rules.allocation: median >= 65536 bytes per rendered frame is a persistent allocation investigation candidate, not proof of game-only allocation
rules.lifetime: persistent extra SceneFlowManager/GameDataStore/EventSystem/PopupHost or closed popup is failure; memory increase alone is not a leak
rules.memory: post-warmup comparable-state Unity used growth >10% and >32 MiB calls for investigation; report managed GC sawtooth separately

limits: No Android FPS or memory pass/fail
No product optimization or implementation changes
No forced GC for main/soak verdict
